description: ONNX export: pre-NMS graph plus Python preprocess and postprocess.

input.name: images
input.value_range: already (x/255 - mean) / std using training normalize_mean / normalize_std
input.spatial: Fixed H,W from export (1024x1024 for this repo).

outputs.pre_nms_count: scalar live count (includes zeroed invalid slots)

preprocess.steps: RGB uint8. If resize_mode is fixed or crop and the image is larger than the slice, tile it (slice is window_size in source pixels when set, otherwise target_size; overlap_pixels default 200; last window flushes to the image edge). Each window is bilinear-resized to target_size. Otherwise bilinear-resize the whole image to target_size. Then /255, subtract mean, divide std, NCHW. pad and keep_ratio are not tiled.

postprocess.impl: export.nms (copied to onnx_export/ at export; python clip or shapely)
postprocess.steps: Per window: score floor → rotated NMS → max_detections_per_image. Map boxes from the canvas back onto the source window (divide by target_size/window_size when window_size is set) and add the window origin. Drop centroids in the zero-pad band. Then one more rotated NMS across windows. A single forward scales boxes to the original image size.

rotated_fcos_pre_nms.notes: Primary delivery. GroupNorm stays in the graph. NMS is Python.

rotated_rtmdet_pre_nms.notes: CSPNeXt + SepBN head + DistanceAnglePointCoder decode. NMS is Python.

faster_rcnn_pre_nms.notes: ROI decode in ONNX. NMS in Python.

rotated_fcos_heads.notes: Head maps only (no decode). Prefer rotated_fcos_pre_nms.
